title: Woolworths Limited - proposed acquisition of Roleystone Trades

timeline.event: ACCC commenced review under the Merger Review Process Guidelines.
Closing date for submissions from interested parties.
ACCC announced it would not oppose the proposed acquisition.

body_sections.Summary: Woolworths proposes to acquire a retail liquor store licence which currently trades as "Cellarbrations at Roleystone" located at Roleystone Shopping Centre, 21 Jarrah Road, Roleystone, WA.
body_sections.Market definition: The proposed acquisition was assessed within the context of the following markets: 1. the local market for the retail sale of packaged liquor for off-premises consumption. The geographic dimension is, at its narrowest, a 3-5km radius surrounding the target retail liquor business; and 2. the Western Australian market for the wholesale supply of packaged liquor for subsequent sale in the retail market for off-premises consumption.
body_sections.Competition analysis: The ACCC formed the view that the proposed acquisition was unlikely to result in a substantial lessening of competition in the relevant markets. Factors informing this conclusion included: 1. Woolworths would be a new entrant in the local retail market and therefore Woolworths is not likely to be able to exert any influence on prices as a result of the acquisition; and 2. The acquisition of one retail licence is unlikely to significantly increase Woolworths' market share (or buying power) or substantially diminish the buying power of any competitor.
